PARTNERSHIP DISSOLUTION DEED 
 This partnership dissolution deed (the “ Deed ” ) of the Deed of Partnership dated 30 th April , 202 2 (the “ Partnership ” ) is made and entered into Lahore on this the ___ day of January, 2023 ( “Effective Date” ) by and between: 
 
 HEXPER ( PRIVATE) LIMITED , a company incorporated and existing under the laws of Pakistan and having its registered office at 94-B/1, Pearl One, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg – III, Lahore hereinafter referred to as “ HEXPER ” through its authorized representative which constitutes the First Part; 
 AND 
 VALENCIA REAL ESTATE &amp; BUILDERS (PVT) LTD , a company incorporated and existing under the laws of Pakistan and having its registered office at Office No. 1, Clock Plaza, Ghanta Ghar , Multan hereinafter referred to as the “ SS ” through its authorized representatives which constitutes the Second Part. 
 ( Hexper and SS shall hereinafter individually referred to as the “ Party ” and collectively as the “ Parties ”) 
 
 The Appendixes, exhibits and recitals attached herewith shall form an integral and operative part of this Termination Agreement. 
 
 WHEREAS : 
 
 Zameen and SS entered into the Partnership to undertake real estate construction, development, marketing and sale project(s) under the name and style of ZSS Developers; 
 
 ZSS Developers was duly incorporated under the Partnership Act, 1932 vide registration No. 5142, Despatch No. RF/LD/6904, dated 19 May 2022 (the “ Partnership Firm ”) ; and 
 
 T he Parties by their mutual concessions, desire to enter into the present Deed to entirely, finally and definitively settle and discharge all of the claims and resolve all the Disputes, whether asserted or claimed on or before the Effective Date or otherwise arose under the Deed . 
 
 NOW THEREFORE, IN VIEW OF THE FOREGOING AND IN CONSIDERATION OF THE MUTUAL BENEFITS TO BE DERIVED AND THE REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES, COVENANTS AND AGREEMENTS CONTAINED HEREIN AND OTHER GOOD AND VALUABLE CONSIDERATION, THE PARTIES HEREBY AGREE AS FOLLOWS: 
 
 Unless the context otherwise requires, the defined terms in this Deed shall have the same meanings as assigned to it under the Partnership . 
 Termination of Deed of Partnership and Partnership Firm 
 The Parties, by and through their respective authorized representatives, hereby mutually agree to terminate and dissolve the Partnership and Partnership Firm , effective immediately. This termination and dissolution shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the Parties, their respective successors and assigns. 
 
 Final Settlement 
 U pon the dissolution of the partnership , and settling all outstanding debts and liabilities of the Partnership Firm t he remaining assets of the partnership shall be distributed among the partners in the following manner : 
 The parties hereby acknowledge that, as of the date of this Deed , the profit value of the Partnership Firm’s Project “Boulevard Heights” is PKR. [-] as per the feasibility Attached as Schedule – A, the same shall be shared between Hexper and SS in accordance with Profit Sharing Formula given in Clause 3.2 of Joint Venture i.e. 75% SS and 25% Hexper . 
 
 The Parties agree that Hexper will be awarded inventory units in Boulevard Heights equivalent to its Profit Share , instead of a monetary amount. The number and details of inventory units are described in Schedule – B below . 
 
 Land in the name of Partnership Firm will be transferred in the name of SS. 
 
 Closure of Bank Accounts 
 Upon dissolution of the P artnership, the Parties shall take the following steps to close all bank accounts held in the name of the P artnership Firm : 
 All outstanding checks and bills shall be honored and all debts and liabilities of the P artnership shall be paid. 
 
 All remaining funds in the accounts shall be distributed among the partners in accordance with their capital contributions to the P artnership. 
 
 The Parties shall provide written notice to the Bank(s) holding the accounts of the dissolution of the P artnership Firm and request that the accounts be closed. 
 
 Each P art y shall provide the Bank(s) with their personal identification and any other required documentation to close the accounts. 
 
 The Parties shall obtain written confirmation from the Bank(s) that the accounts have been closed. 
 
 EFFECTIVENESS 
 This Deed shall become effective and shall be deemed to be effective as of the Effective Date hereof. 
 For the avoidance of doubt, it is clarified that the provisions of this Deed shall take effect notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in the Partnership . In the event of any conflict, discrepancy and/or inconsistency between this Deed and the Partnership , the provisions of this Deed shall prevail. 
 
 RELEASE AND DISCHARGE 
 Subject to correct and complete performance of their respective obligations under this Deed , each of the Parties hereby releases and discharges the other and/or their past or present employees, directors, managers or agents from any and all claims and causes of action pursued by themselves, or their affiliates or subsidiaries, on the basis of or in relation to any fact, element, document, omission, action, transaction, event or fault which occurred prior to the Effective Date, or which directly or indirectly connected to or pertaining to the Partneship . 
 
 ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS 
 The Parties acknowledge and agree as follows: 
 
 Neither Party has assigned or otherwise transferred to any party any claim that is being released pursuant to this Deed ; 
 
 Neither Party has filed any complaint, charge, or demand against the other involving any events up to and including the date of this Deed ; 
 
 Each Party shall be responsible for its own legal fees, costs and expenses arising out of or in connection to this Deed ; 
 
 The Parties further agree to cooperate fully and execute any and all supplementary documents and to take all additional actions which may be necessary or appropriate to give full force and effect to the terms of this Deed ; and 
 
 The Parties agree to act in good faith in relation to the performance of each Party’s obligations under this Deed . 
 
 CONFIDENTIALITY 
 The Parties agree to keep confidential and not disclose to any third party the terms and conditions of this Deed and the Partnership , except as is necessary to effectuate any term or provision of this Deed , including any subsequent litigation to enforce this Deed , or except as required by law or court order. The Parties may submit this Deed to its lenders (and related advisors) and relevant governmental departments/regulatory institutions including the Federal Board of Revenue, State Bank of Pakistan, National Electric Power Regulatory Authority or any other . 
 
 INDEMNITY 
 Each of the Parties shall indemnify and keep the other Party hereto indemnified on demand and shall defend and, hold the other Party hereto harmless from and against all present and future liabilities, losses, damages, expenses and claims of any nature whatsoever by any person for any and all losses or damages arising out of or in any way connected with the indemnifying Party's breach hereof and any negligent or wilful act or omission of the indemnifying Party hereunder. 
 
 CONTRA PROFERENTUM 
 Thi s Deed was drafted by both of the Parties and, thus, shall not be construed against any Party because that Party initially drafted any particular provision. 
 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 This Deed (together with the Recitals and Annexures hereto) is intended by the Parties as the final expression of their agreement on the matters contained in the Deed and Partnership , and is also intended as a complete and exclusive statement of the terms of their agreement with respect to the Deed and Partnership . All prior written or oral representations, understandings, offers or other communications of every kind pertaining to the Deed and Partnership between the Parties are hereby superseded. 
 
 SEVERABILITY 
 If any provision of this Deed is found under the laws of any jurisdiction to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable it shall to that extent be deemed not to form part of this Deed . The invalidity, illegality or unenforceability of that provision in that jurisdiction shall not in any way affect the other provisions of this Deed in that jurisdiction, and shall not affect the validity, legality or enforceability of all the provisions of the Deed in any other jurisdiction. 
 
 The Parties shall attempt to substitute for any invalid, illegal or unenforceable provision a valid, legal and enforceable provision that achieves to the greatest extent possible the economic, legal and commercial objectives of the invalid, illegal or unenforceable provision. 
 
 BINDING EFFECT 
 This Deed shall be binding on the Parties, their successors in interest, and present and future affiliates, subsidiaries, assignees or acquirers, including any acquirer of substantially all of the assets of a Party. 
 
 APPLICABLE LAWS 
 This Deed , and any dispute or claim (including non-contractual disputes or claims) arising out of or in connection with it or its subject matter, shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Islamic Republic of Pakistan. 
 
 DISPUTE RESOLUTION 
 Any dispute, controversy or claim arising out of or relating to the conclusion, interpretation or performance of this Deed , or the breach, termination or invalidity thereof, shall be definitively referred to the competent Courts in Lahore . 
 
 IN WITNESS HEREOF, the Parties have read and understood the above-mentioned terms and conditions laid in this Deed and undertake to abide by all the terms and conditions of this Deed strictly. Furthermore, Parties have caused their duly authorized representatives to execute this Deed to be effective as of the Effective Date. 
 
 SIGNATORIES:

 Builders (PVT) Ltd.
